answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable performance bond before its first challenge answer can enter a jury. The bond splits into an onyx reserve returned after N distinct established jurors attest unique work, an ember slice slashed if graders detect near-duplicate wording, and a saffron slice slashed if multiple identities share one vault key or identical parent graph. An attacker minting thousands of names must post and risk that full bond on every head, so flood cost scales linearly while honest single identities recover the stake after a clean window.
